reference_change.summary: Add a migration renaming the documented customer_ref receipt column to account_ref and require consumers to update their queries.
reference_change.rationale: The intended terminology is account reference rather than customer reference.
reference_change.limitations: The old SQL name is removed without an alias; out-of-repository consumers must coordinate updates. Rollback and database-specific compatibility are not demonstrated.
